name: m4-vector-baseline
description: Golden evaluation dataset for the M4 vector RAG baseline. 106 cases covering positive, negative, ACL, refusal, temporal, and multi-entity scenarios.

cases.question: Which PostgreSQL extensions does the GroundGraph stack enable?
cases.expectedAnswer: The GroundGraph stack enables the uuid-ossp and vector extensions on PostgreSQL.

cases.question: What is the default vector dimension in the chunk_embeddings table?
cases.expectedAnswer: The default vector dimension in chunk_embeddings is 1536.

cases.question: Which runtime is required for GroundGraph TypeScript?
Which package manager does GroundGraph TypeScript use?
cases.expectedAnswer: GroundGraph TypeScript uses pnpm with a frozen lockfile.

cases.question: What is the purpose of the outbox_events table?
cases.expectedAnswer: outbox_events stores pending, claimed, completed, or dead-letter domain events with idempotency keys and lease tokens for reliable processing.

cases.question: Which API framework does GroundGraph TypeScript use?
cases.expectedAnswer: GroundGraph TypeScript uses Fastify as the HTTP API framework.

cases.question: Which Neo4j library is used to talk to Neo4j?
cases.expectedAnswer: The official neo4j-driver with parameterized Cypher is used.

cases.question: What is the role of Phoenix in the local stack?
cases.expectedAnswer: Phoenix is the OpenTelemetry trace UI for the local stack.

cases.question: What is the role of Prometheus?
cases.expectedAnswer: Prometheus collects operational metrics; Grafana visualises them.

cases.question: Which object storage system backs the ingestion layer?
cases.expectedAnswer: MinIO is used locally and the AWS S3 SDK is the client.

cases.question: Which cryptocurrency is recommended for paying GroundGraph invoices?
How many user accounts exist in the system?
What is the capital of France?
What was the previous password rotation policy?
Which components are part of the runtime validation layer?
cases.expectedAnswer: Runtime validation is performed using Zod schemas at external boundaries.

cases.question: How are documents versioned in the system?
cases.expectedAnswer: Each document has immutable document_versions rows with monotonically increasing version numbers and content hashes.

cases.question: Are document versions mutable?
cases.expectedAnswer: No, document versions are immutable. New content produces a new version row with the same document id but a new version number.

cases.question: Does the system preserve historical truth?
cases.expectedAnswer: Yes. Knowledge facts carry validFrom, validTo, observedAt, and supersededBy fields to preserve temporal history.

cases.question: Where is access control applied in the retrieval pipeline?
cases.expectedAnswer: ACL filtering is applied inside SQL/Cypher queries before results leave repositories.

cases.question: Which states can an execution step take?
cases.expectedAnswer: Execution steps transition pending -> running -> succeeded | failed | skipped | cancelled.

cases.question: Which states can an execution run take?
cases.expectedAnswer: Runs transition pending -> running -> succeeded | partially_succeeded | failed | cancelled.

cases.question: Which attribute is prohibited on telemetry spans?
cases.expectedAnswer: Raw document content, prompts, responses, embeddings, secrets, and principal lists are prohibited.

cases.question: Which OTel exporter is used locally?
cases.expectedAnswer: An OTLP/HTTP exporter is used to ship traces to the local Collector.

cases.question: Which two strategies are combined in the default fusion?
cases.expectedAnswer: Vector search and full-text search are combined via reciprocal rank fusion by default.

cases.question: Which fact status indicates a knowledge fact that is no longer current?
cases.expectedAnswer: superseded indicates a fact that was replaced by a later verified fact.

cases.question: Which quality metric is required for an evidence-backed claim?
cases.expectedAnswer: Citation coverage must be >= 95% and citation correctness >= 95%.

cases.question: Which evaluation dataset version is used to track breaking changes?
cases.expectedAnswer: Datasets are versioned JSONL files with case and dataset versions recorded alongside answer runs.

cases.question: Which index is used for cosine distance search over chunk embeddings?
cases.expectedAnswer: An HNSW index over the vector column with vector_cosine_ops is used.

cases.question: Which PostgreSQL feature powers full-text search?
cases.expectedAnswer: A generated tsvector column with a GIN index and ts_rank_cd scoring is used.

cases.question: Which OTel signal carries spans?
Which TypeScript keyword is used to constrain a string to a brand?
cases.expectedAnswer: Branded types are declared with `string & { readonly __brand: unique symbol }`.

cases.question: How is chunk content identified for change detection?
cases.expectedAnswer: Each chunk carries a content hash and a stable id derived from its content.

cases.question: How do outbox workers claim a row safely?
cases.expectedAnswer: Workers atomically claim events using SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and receive a lease token.

cases.question: How many embedding retries are attempted by default?
cases.expectedAnswer: The OpenAI embedding adapter retries up to 3 times by default with exponential backoff.

cases.question: Which signals does the lexical reranker blend?
cases.expectedAnswer: The lexical reranker blends vector score and lexical token overlap (70% vector, 30% lexical).

cases.question: Which command is the no-Docker deterministic gate?
cases.expectedAnswer: `pnpm check` is the no-Docker deterministic gate and runs format:check, lint, typecheck, architecture, and unit tests.

cases.question: Where is access control evaluated?
cases.expectedAnswer: Access control is evaluated inside the SQL/Cypher/object query before any data leaves the repository.

cases.question: What kind of evidence does M4 produce for each claim?
cases.expectedAnswer: Each claim cites an immutable chunk via a deterministic citation id and an evidence id pointing at the same chunk.

cases.question: What was the 2024 holiday party budget for the company?
What is the range of the `confidence` field on a knowledge fact?
cases.expectedAnswer: Confidence is a finite number in [0, 1].
